about: Lane E2-P-CONN1: engine 2 binds engine 1's remote tool servers (src/agent/tools_plain_connectors.cpp). Discovery (connectors::mcp::sync) runs on tg_poll before a person's turn, measured here. A call (connectors::mcp::callTool) runs on tg_poll inside the turn through more; the gate does not follow engine 2's tool dispatch (TurnRun::runCall to the registry is an unresolved indirect call, so no engine-2 tool handler is reached), so that path is estimated by hand in the lane's PR_BODY.md. Both open their TLS session under the one work slot (arbiter::WorkSlot), between the head's requests.
